body.content: Exploration of grid perturbation for 13 points. A 4x4 grid has 16 points; we need to remove 3. If we remove (0,0), (1,1), and (0.5, 0.5), the remaining 13 points might have large minimum triangle areas. The constraint is the 286 triangles formed by triples.
body.why_keep_this: To track the geometric arrangement and test if removing specific points from a dense grid maximizes the minimum triangle area.
